inventionTitles.title: 一种生物技术基因检测装置

address.address1: Beijing Huarui innovation Intellectual Property Agency Co., Ltd

event-title.$: TERMINATION OF PATENT RIGHT DUE TO NON-PAYMENT OF ANNUAL FEE

section.content: 本实用新型属于检测装置技术领域，尤其为一种生物技术基因检测装置，包括底板，所述底板的下端面固定连接有万向轮，所述底板上端面的四个角处均固定连接有安装柱，所述安装柱的侧壁上均固定连接有安装块，所述安装块的下端面固定连接有滑柱，且滑柱的底端与底板的上端面固定连接，所述滑柱上滑动连接有滑板，所述底板的上端面对称且固定连接两块固定板。本实用新型通过设置电机、主动轮、从动轮、皮带、螺纹杆和转杆，方便对生物技术基因检测装置的高度进行灵活的调节，减轻检测人员的疲劳感，通过消毒箱、储存盒、挡板、卡板和紫外线灯，方便对检测用的试管进行消毒处理，避免对检测结果造成影响。

The utility model belongs to the technical field of detection device, especially, be a biotechnology gene detection device, comprising a base plate, the lower terminal surface fixedly connected with universal wheel of bottom plate, the equal fixedly connected with erection column of four angle departments of bottom plate up end, equal fixedly connected with installation piece on the lateral wall of erection column, the lower terminal surface fixedly connected with traveller of installation piece, and the bottom of traveller and the up end fixed connection of bottom plate, sliding connection has the slide on the traveller, two fixed plates of up end symmetry and fixed connection of bottom plate. The utility model discloses a set up motor, action wheel, from driving wheel, belt, threaded rod and bull stick, conveniently highly carry out nimble regulation to biotechnology gene detection device, alleviate measurement personnel's fatigue and feel, through disinfect box, storage box, baffle, cardboard and ultraviolet lamp, the test tube of convenient usefulness to detecting is disinfected, avoids causing the influence to the testing result.

Biotechnological gene detection deviceTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a detection device technical field specifically is a biotechnology gene detection device.

Background

In the field of biotechnology, gene detection is an important means for life research, and biological genetic engineering plays a very important role in medicine and makes a great contribution to the healthy life of people, and a biological genetic detection device is an indispensable device in genetic engineering.

At present, the biotechnology gene detection device among the prior art's highly invariant, the inconvenient regulation of carrying on the height, because the difference of measurement personnel height, and the time of measuring is longer, and uncomfortable highly leads to measurement personnel's fatigue to aggravate easily, and the biotechnology gene detection device among the prior art simultaneously, the test tube of just using detecting carries out germicidal treatment, causes the influence to the testing result easily.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

Technical problem to be solved

Not enough to prior art, the utility model provides a biotechnology gene detection device has solved among the prior art biotechnology gene detection device inconveniently carries out altitude mixture control and the inconvenient test tube of using to the detection problem of disinfecting and storing.

As an optimal technical scheme of the utility model, equal sliding connection has the slide bar in the erection column, the top of slide bar and the lower terminal surface fixed connection of workstation.

As an optimized technical scheme of the utility model, the fixedly connected with protection pad on the interior diapire of storage box, the protection pad is made by rubber materials.

As a preferred technical scheme of the utility model, be equipped with a set of hole of placing on the cardboard, and adjacent the interval of placing between the hole is the same.

As an optimized technical scheme of the utility model, the cross sectional shape of pulling the handle is C word shape, and the surface of pulling the handle is equipped with anti-skidding line.

As an optimal technical scheme of the utility model, the quantity of universal wheel is four, and all has the brake block on four universal wheels.

(III) advantageous effects

Compared with the prior art, the utility model provides a biotechnology gene testing device possesses following beneficial effect:

1. this biotechnology gene detection device through motor, action wheel, from driving wheel, belt, threaded rod and bull stick, conveniently carries out nimble regulation to biotechnology gene detection device's height, and the detection personnel that make things convenient for different heights use, can provide a comfortable detection environment for the detection personnel, alleviate detection personnel's tired sense, and degree of automation is stronger, and the practicality is better.

2. This biotechnology gene detection device through disinfect box, storage box, baffle, cardboard and ultraviolet lamp, conveniently disinfects the test tube of usefulness, avoids causing the influence to the testing result, and the convenience is stored the test tube of usefulness of detecting, avoids appearing the phenomenon of ash that falls, and the protecting effect is better, and the practicality is stronger.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative work belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

Examples

In this embodiment, the universal wheel 2 is convenient to move, the flexibility is better, the sliding column 5 facilitates the sliding plate 6 to stably slide up and down, so as to conveniently flexibly adjust the height of the workbench 18, the driving end of the motor 10 can drive the driving wheel 11 to rotate, the driving wheel 11 can drive the driven wheel 9 to rotate through the belt 12, the rotation of the driven wheel 9 can drive the threaded rod 8 to rotate, the rotation of the threaded rod 8 can drive the moving block 13 to move, the movement of the moving block 13 can drive the rotating rod 16 to rotate, the rotation of the rotating rod 16 can drive the height of the sliding plate 6 to change, the change of the height of the sliding plate 6 can drive the height of the workbench 18 to change, so as to facilitate the use of a tester, the gene tester 19 can conveniently test genes, the sterilizing box 20 can conveniently sterilize and disinfect test tubes for testing, thereby avoiding affecting the testing result, the handle 22 facilitates the operator to pull the storage box 21, baffle 23 can seal up disinfect box 20, and cardboard 25 is convenient to carry on spacingly to the test tube that detects the usefulness, and ultraviolet lamp 27 is convenient to the test tube disinfection processing that disinfects.

Specifically, the mounting columns 3 are all connected with sliding rods 24 in a sliding manner, and the top ends of the sliding rods 24 are fixedly connected with the lower end face of the workbench 18.

In this embodiment, the slide bar 24 can move the table 18 up and down stably, and is more stable in the process of adjusting the height.

Specifically, a protective pad 26 is fixedly connected to the inner bottom wall of the storage box 21, and the protective pad 26 is made of a rubber material.

In this embodiment, protection pad 26 can protect the test tube of detection usefulness, avoids the test tube and the interior diapire of storing box 21 to take place rigid collision.

Specifically, a group of placing holes is formed in the clamping plate 25, and the distance between every two adjacent placing holes is the same.

In this embodiment, place the hole and conveniently carry on spacingly with the test tube to conveniently place the test tube in cardboard 25, conveniently store the test tube.

Specifically, the cross-sectional shape of the pull handle 22 is a C-shape, and the outer surface of the pull handle 22 is provided with anti-slip threads.

In this embodiment, pull handle 22 makes things convenient for the testing personnel to pull out storage box 21, and the frictional force between testing personnel's hand and the pull handle 22 can be increased to the antiskid line.

Specifically, the number of the universal wheels 2 is four, and the four universal wheels 2 are provided with brake pads.

In this embodiment, this detection device is carried out nimble removal to universal wheel 2 convenience, and the brake block is convenient to be fixed universal wheel 2, can also ensure stability when conveniently removing.

The utility model discloses a theory of operation and use flow: when needs carry out height control, starter motor 10 works, the drive end drive action wheel 11 of motor 10 rotates, action wheel 11 makes through belt 12 and rotates from driving wheel 9, make threaded rod 8 rotate from the rotation of driving wheel 9, threaded rod 8's rotation makes movable block 13 move, movable block 13's removal makes bull stick 16 rotate, bull stick 16's rotation makes slide 6's height change, slide 6's height change makes workstation 18's height change, when needs disinfect the test tube and store, the measurement personnel will store box 21 and pull out through pulling handle 22, place the test tube in cardboard 25, again will store box 21 and push, open ultraviolet lamp 27, make things convenient for the follow-up detection of measurement personnel to use, avoid causing the influence to the result of measuring.

Finally, it should be noted that: although the present invention has been described in detail with reference to the foregoing embodiments, it will be apparent to those skilled in the art that modifications may be made to the embodiments described in the foregoing embodiments, or equivalents may be substituted for elements thereof. Any modification, equivalent replacement, or improvement made within the spirit and principle of the present invention should be included in the protection scope of the present invention.
